rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when the conclusion can be inferred from the evidence.

example.english: We can evidently tell that he never went out.
example.traditional: 佢件衫仲乾，我哋睇得出佢根本冇出過街。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin6 saam1 zung6 gon1 ngo5 dei6 tai2 dak1 ceot1 keoi5 gan1 bun2 mou5 ceot1 gwo3 gaai1

rows.note: Use this when the fact is plainly obvious, especially before a clause such as 好明顯佢唔想去.

example.english: Evidently, he does not want to go; he has not said a word all evening.
example.traditional: 好明顯佢唔想去，成晚都唔出聲。
example.jyutping: hou2 ming4 hin2 keoi5 m4 soeng2 heoi3 seng4 maan5 dou1 m4 ceot1 seng1

rows.note: Use this formal written adverb when stating that a conclusion is clearly evident.

example.english: Evidently, this arrangement has failed to solve the problem.
example.traditional: 顯然，呢個安排未能解決問題。
example.jyutping: hin2 jin4 ni1 go3 on1 paai4 mei6 nang4 gaai2 kyut3 man6 tai4
